The '''ghost cell''' was an organization of expert [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and saboteurs that operated during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Based on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the cell was devoted to the training of assassins, and it aided individuals in furthering their skills before sending them back out into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], where operatives worked undercover to complete their assignments.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Ghost Cell}}</ref>

In the Cold War era, their existence was considered a legend within the intelligence community, who believed that they were a myth to explain disasters that had no explanation. Both [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] and the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] had never found any proof of the Ghost cell's existence. The only basis for the legend was the fact that informants spoke of the organization in a recurrent manner, but none of these individuals ever survived long enough to be debriefed.<ref name="TORC" />

During this time, the [[Eagle]]'s terrorist network was supported by the training provided by the Ghost cell. Furthermore, they gained a resource in [[Milosh Varta]] where they offered protection and assassinations for the [[Exchange]] in return for their aid. After striking at [[Darth Jadus]], Imperial Intelligence assigned [[Cipher Nine]] with dismantling the Eagle's network and saw the [[Cipher Agent]] travel to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where the Ghost cell had established a base of operations to support the training of its operatives.

The Ghost cell saw an opportunity to lure the Cipher Agent to their camp and replace Nine with a doppelganger to infiltrate Imperial Intelligence. To this end, their leader, only known as "[[Old Man (Ghost cell)|the Old Man]]," purposely let [[Mia Hawkins]], a recruit who became dissatisfied with the cell's methods of using civilians for target practice, escape them, knowing that she would go to Imperial Intelligence. The Ghost cell performed a dual task, sending assassins after Cipher Nine in [[Jundland]] while at the same time studying the agent's operational tactics. But when the agent finally arrived at their base, Nine killed the Old Man, effectively dismantling the Ghost cell.
